title: Design of Equilibrium Cells for Phase Equilibria and PVT Measurements in Large Ranges of Temperatures and Pressures. I. Vapor–Liquid–Liquid Equilibria
experimental_method: Rotating high-T/high-P equilibrium cell (70 cm3) with high-pressure samplers and GC analysis of both phases; propane-water used as validation system.
uncertainties_stated: u(T)=0.02 K, u(p)=10 kPa; u(x1) = 2*standard deviation per row

not_extracted_tables.Table 3: cyclohexane in water: no in-scope component
not_extracted_tables.Table 4: water in cyclohexane: no in-scope component (organic solvent)

quality_remarks: Only one temperature (about 323.15 K) for propane, intended as apparatus validation. Footnote of Table 4 defines x1exp although table is x2 (copy error in paper, irrelevant to extracted table). Abstract says 'up to 498.8 K' for hydrocarbon/cyclohexane, not propane; propane table consistent with text (one temperature, four pressures).
extraction_notes: Table 2 header was two rows; joined to ASCII. Footnote letter a belongs to caption only.
mapping_audit: independent mapping audit 2026-10-02 (audit.json); cell-for-cell match with the captured HTML rows
